title: Higher Categorical Symmetries and Defect Algebras

items.title: Finite semisimple module category over a fusion category
items.statement: Defines finite semisimple right C-module categories, module functors, and module-natural transformations, with the action coherence and source/target conventions.

items.title: G-graded finite semisimple 2-vector space
items.statement: Defines a finite G-graded finite semisimple C-linear category by its homogeneous summands, grading-preserving linear functors, and natural transformations, for finite G and algebraically closed C.

items.title: Separable algebra objects and bimodules in a fusion category
items.statement: Defines algebra objects, separability sections, A-B bimodules, bimodule maps, and balanced tensor products in a finite semisimple monoidal category.

items.title: Weak linear 2-category
items.statement: Fixes objects, hom categories, identity 1-morphisms, bilinear horizontal composition, associator and unit natural isomorphisms, their pentagon and triangle, and interchange.

items.title: Finite semisimple 2-category
items.statement: Defines finite semisimplicity by locally finite semisimple hom categories, finite direct sums, adjoints for every 1-morphism, splittings of separable monads, and finitely many simple-object equivalence classes.

items.title: Relative Deligne product in the braided module 2-category
items.statement: Defines the relative Deligne product in Mod(C) by its exact middle-balanced, outer-module-compatible universal property and fixes the right-to-left action convention using the braiding; it claims no existence.

items.title: Weak monoidal 2-category and Gray-monoid presentation
items.statement: Defines a weak monoidal 2-category by tensor pseudofunctor, unit, associator and unit equivalences, pentagonator and unit modifications with coherence; also records the full D1-D4/C1-C6 semistrict Gray-monoid alternative without deleting its interchanger.

items.title: Opposite algebra induced by a braiding
items.statement: Defines A^op for a braided fusion category by transporting the algebra in the monoidal opposite along the braiding equivalence; the multiplication is m_A composed with c_{A,A}^{-1}.

items.title: A uniform rank bound for indecomposable module categories over C
items.statement: Required local result: gives a finite bound depending only on a fixed fusion category C for the number of simple objects in any indecomposable finite semisimple C-module category.

items.title: Categorical separability contracts the module deformation complex
items.statement: Required local result: fixes the normalized deformation complex for the module action and writes a separability contracting homotopy proving its positive-degree cohomology vanishes.

items.title: Module functor adjoints and separable-monad splittings in Mod(C)
items.statement: Required local result: finite semisimple module functors have left and right module adjoints by mates, and every separable monad in Mod(C) splits through its finite semisimple module category.

items.title: A separability idempotent constructs the balanced relative tensor product
items.statement: For separable B and an A-B bimodule X and B-D bimodule Y, proves that the image of the separability projector on X tensor Y corepresents balanced maps and is independent up to a unique canonical isomorphism of the image splitting.

items.title: A braiding gives the tensor product algebra structure
items.statement: For braided fusion C and algebra objects A,B, verifies the multiplication (m_A tensor m_B)(id_A tensor c_B,A tensor id_B), its unit, and associativity for A tensor B.

items.title: Finite semisimple module categories are separable algebra modules
items.statement: Constructs the correctly oriented internal-end separable algebra for every finite semisimple right C-module category and proves the module equivalence to its algebra modules, including the corresponding Eilenberg–Watts description of module functors by bimodules.

items.title: Four-cocycle twisted monoidal structure on 2Vect_G
items.statement: Defines convolution grading, unit normalization, canonical rebracketing, and the scalar pentagonator omega(g,h,k,l) for a normalized group 4-cocycle.

items.title: Fusion 2-category
items.statement: A finite semisimple linear monoidal 2-category with simple tensor unit and left and right dual objects, including evaluation and coevaluation 1-morphisms and cusp 2-isomorphisms.

items.title: The braided tensor product of separable algebras is separable
items.statement: For separable A and B, proves the candidate section (id_A tensor c_{B,A}^{-1} tensor id_B)(sigma_A tensor sigma_B) is a bimodule section of the braided tensor-product multiplication.

items.title: Bounded-rank module-structure varieties have finitely many open orbits
items.statement: Required local result: defines the finite-type variety of module constraints at fixed rank, identifies tangent directions modulo basis changes with the deformation cohomology, and proves finitely many open change-of-basis orbits.

items.title: Module-functor categories are finite semisimple
items.statement: Proves that module functor categories between finite semisimple C-module categories are finite semisimple by the separable-algebra/bimodule model.

items.title: Relative tensor product gives associative composition of separable bimodules
items.statement: Proves associativity, unitors, pentagon, and interchange for the bicategory of separable algebra objects, bimodules, and bimodule maps using the universal property of balanced relative tensor products.

items.title: Object duals in the separable-algebra model of Mod(C)
items.statement: Required local result: constructs the opposite-algebra dual and evaluation/coevaluation bimodules, then checks both cusp composites for the Mod(C) object model.

items.title: A normalized group 4-cocycle gives a fusion 2-category 2Vect_G^omega
items.statement: For finite G and normalized omega in Z^4(G; C^times), verifies the five-object coherence equation and proves that 2Vect_G^omega is finite semisimple, has adjoints and separable-monad splittings, has |G| simple-object classes and simple unit, and has dual objects with the stated cusp scalars.

items.title: The relative Deligne product is represented by the braided tensor algebra
items.statement: Proves existence and the universal property of the relative Deligne product of finite semisimple right C-module categories, its finite semisimplicity, and its equivalence to modules over the braided tensor product algebra, independent of algebra presentations.

items.title: A normalized 3-cochain gives the gauge equivalence of 2Vect_G^omega
items.statement: If omega-prime divided by omega is the coboundary of a normalized 3-cochain beta, constructs and checks the identity-on-grading monoidal 2-equivalence; within this gauge family, coherent untwisting exists exactly when [omega]=0.

items.title: The algebraic 2-category Mod(C) is a fusion 2-category
items.statement: For a braided fusion category C over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, proves that finite semisimple right C-module categories, module functors, and module-natural transformations form a fusion 2-category, with simple unit, object duals, adjoints, separable-monad splittings, and finitely many simple-object equivalence classes.

items.title: Conditional weighted RT background interface for Mod(C)
items.statement: Defines the conditional use of PA-47 weighted RT state spaces and bordism maps as background alongside the algebraic Mod(C) defect 2-category, without identifying algebraic module data with physical defects.

title: Higher Categorical Symmetries and Defect Algebras: Examples and Counterexamples

items.title: Matrix 2-vector spaces exhibit horizontal and vertical composition
items.statement: Computes finite matrix composition of linear functors and natural transformations, including the interchange square.

items.title: Typed object, 1-morphism, and 2-morphism defect composition
items.statement: Checks the mathematical source and target types for object tensor product, 1-morphism composition, and 2-morphism vertical/horizontal composition; it makes no physical realization claim.

items.title: Relative tensor products of bimodules over C times C
items.statement: For R=C times C, calculates the tensor product of matrix-unit R-R bimodules and verifies the relative tensor rule by the separability projector.

items.title: A C4 coboundary changes the pentagonator and is gauged away
items.statement: Defines an explicit normalized 3-cochain on C4, calculates a nontrivial value of its 4-coboundary, and verifies the cochain gauge equivalence.

items.title: The trivial group gives ordinary 2Vect
items.statement: Checks G={e}, the unique normalized 4-cocycle, the simple unit, and the unique simple-object class.
